name: Neuweg Industries LLC
old_description: Striving to be your partner for fabrication and machining solutions.
about:
Neuweg Industries LLC operates from Milnor, North Dakota. The company provides fabrication and machining services, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It positions itself as a partner for metal fabrication and machining solutions.

The shop runs a range of metalworking processes: flat laser cutting, tube laser cutting on a 3D machine equipped with both a bundle loader for high-volume runs and a single bar loader for small batches, press brake forming using CNC hydraulic brakes with CAD/CAM programming, and CNC machining that covers milling, turning, routing, and sawing. Welding capacity includes both manual stations and robotic cells. Tube bending is handled on an NC rotary draw bender suited for pipe, tube, square, rectangular, and solid profiles up to large diameters. Additional services include sheet and tube rolling, plus finishing and deburring to remove sharp edges. The facility supports bar feed up to 3 inches in diameter and 4 feet in length, with Y-axis capability on its machining centers.

Neuweg serves customers needing precision metal fabrication and machining, though specific industry sectors are not listed in its public materials. Its equipment mix suggests work for agricultural, construction, energy, and general industrial markets that require laser-cut sheet metal, formed components, welded assemblies, and bent tubing.

The company states it is committed to outstanding customer service and superior products, aiming to be a responsive partner that uses advanced planning tools to react promptly to customer needs.
